parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to delete all tags. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

Default value: **false**

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource. Valid values of N: **1** to **50**.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to **DOMAIN**.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The key of the tag. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn untag-dcdn-resources --resource-type DOMAIN --all false --resource-id example000.com --tag-key env --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn UntagDcdnResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'example000.com' --TagKey.1 env --ResourceType DOMAIN
